meta.name: aJay Financial Night Editorial
meta.scope: Single-security main report. Portfolio and versus reports receive branding changes only.
meta.source_kind: Local source inspection; not a browser-certified visual snapshot.
meta.reference_use: Macro layout, capsule navigation, typographic hierarchy and chapter rhythm only.
reference_exclusions: No Vantara logo, photography or text
No GT Ultra or other reference-site font files
No claim of affiliation or endorsement
meta.latest_user_direction: Obsidian, deep navy and metallic silver; financial city night photography, not nature or soft warm palettes.

theme.preference: Explicit stored reader choice overrides the dark default.

compatibility_aliases.--ajay-forest: Deep navy #0a1422; the legacy name is not a green direction.
compatibility_aliases.--neon-cyan: Restrained steel-blue accent, no neon glow requirement.
compatibility_aliases.--neon-gold: Silver accent, not a gold/night-sunset palette.

color.semantics: Keep data direction, warning and missing-state distinctions visible; color is not the only signal.
color.verification: Read from report-editorial.css. Contrast and complete computed-style combinations await runtime verification.

typography.font_loading: System fonts only; no font CDN.
typography.notes: Actual font availability and line wrapping vary by operating system; browser inspection is required.

toc.contract: Stable section anchors, scroll-spy and explicit expand/collapse; no content obstruction.

components: A-I role filters and expandable notes

design_style.composition: A large photographic introduction followed by evidence-led long-form reading, alternating analytical density and clear chapter separation.
design_style.imagery: Cool silver/steel window grids and deep navy water/sky. Black-and-white generated methodology portraits.
design_style.brand_voice: Specific, evidence-aware and explicit about uncertainty; no theatrical certainty or implied famous-investor endorsement.

hero.technology: CSS object-fit image plus restrained dark linear gradients

portraits.technology: CSS object-fit with lower gradient caption area

generated_assets.nature: AI-generated photographic-style depictions, not real photo sessions.

overall_score.interpretation: Heuristic research score, not a calibrated probability.

rules.interpretation: Executable-rule ratio; may include default features.

consensus.interpretation: Agreement among simulated roles sharing inputs; not independent votes or win probability.

history.requires: At least two positive finite observations; do not fabricate missing paths.

data_presentation_contract.agent_review: Current input fingerprint matching is AI review freshness, not human approval.
data_presentation_contract.conditional_prices: Use valid current reviewed assumptions; do not relabel fixed price multipliers as DCF or historical percentiles.

demo.name: Aster Systems
demo.quality_gate_skip: Allowed only for explicitly disclosed UI fixture; environment restored afterward.

delivery.standard: full-report.html + adjacent avatars/; main CSS and four PNGs are already embedded.
delivery.standalone: Run inline_assets.py for full-report-standalone.html; verify all avatars are inlined.
delivery.runtime_network: No automatic font CDN, QR request, telemetry or report upload; explicit source links may be opened by the reader.

exports.note: Raster dimensions depend on screenshot scale; file size is not a fidelity metric.

required: Standalone file moved and opened offline
